title: Petrol price down by Rs2.93 per litre, high-speed diesel rate up by Re0.61
summary: The government on Monday reduced the price of petrol by Rs2.93 per litre, but increased that of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Re0.61 per litre. Following the revision, petrol will retail at Rs395.37 per litre, while HSD will cost Rs396.85 per litre. The government continues to levy Rs114 per litre in taxes and duties on petrol and Rs100 per litre on diesel. According to the Petroleum Division’s notification, the new prices are applicable for Oct 13 (Tuesday). The price of HSD has come down from a peak of Rs520.35 recorded on April 3.
